text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analyst Daniel McConvey on Monday cut his rating for Canadian gold mining company Bre-X Minerals Ltd to neutral from outperform.

-- The downgrade was prompted by "the uncertainty created by the combination of last week's apparent suicide of chief geologist Michael de Guzman and the mysterious press report that Freeport's (Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc (FCX.N ) due diligence is not going well," he wrote in a a report.
-- "While shaken by recent events, we believe that the Busang discovery exists as Bre-X has disclosed it."
-- The company's shares were unchanged at 11 in New York.
-- De Guzman fell from a helicopter last week on his way to the huge Busang gold property he helped discover in Indonesia.

-- An Indonesian newspaper also reported Busang partner Freeport-McMoRan's review showed the deposit was smaller than Bre-X's estimate. Freeport-McMoRan said on Friday its due diligence of the site was not finished.
